endpoints.purpose: Sends a 4-digit login OTP code to the user's mobile number via SMS.
endpoints.useCase: Used on the Login screen when a user enters their phone number to log in or create an account.
endpoints.flow: User enters phone number -> Server generates 4-digit OTP and sends SMS -> App opens OTP screen with a 60s timer.

endpoints.purpose: Verifies the 4-digit OTP and logs the user into their account.
endpoints.useCase: Used on the OTP verification screen when the user enters the 4-digit code received via SMS.
endpoints.flow: User inputs OTP -> Server checks code -> Server logs user in and returns profile details -> App opens Dashboard (if approved) or Onboarding (if pending).

endpoints.purpose: Resends a new 4-digit OTP if the previous SMS was not received.
endpoints.useCase: Used when the user taps 'Resend OTP' after the 60-second timer finishes.
endpoints.flow: User taps Resend OTP -> Server sends a fresh SMS code -> Timer resets to 60s.

endpoints.purpose: Renews the user's login token in the background so they stay logged in without interruption.
endpoints.useCase: Used automatically by the app when the current access token expires.
endpoints.flow: App detects expired token -> App calls refresh in background -> Server issues new token -> User continues using app smoothly.

endpoints.purpose: Saves what kind of account the user wants (Rental Vendor, Machine Driver, or Material Supplier).
endpoints.useCase: Used right after first-time login to pick account type.
endpoints.flow: User selects account card (e.g. Rental Vendor) -> Server saves preference -> App opens Step 1 profile form.

endpoints.purpose: Gets the full onboarding checklist showing which steps are completed, pending, Digio-verified, or rejected.
endpoints.useCase: Used when opening the Onboarding screen to see remaining steps.
endpoints.flow: App opens Onboarding -> Server checks Digio verification results and KYC status -> App highlights completed and pending steps.

endpoints.purpose: Quick check to see if the user is approved or still completing onboarding.
endpoints.useCase: Used every time the app opens on startup to decide which screen to display.
endpoints.flow: App starts up -> Server checks account status -> If approved, opens Dashboard; if not, opens Onboarding.

endpoints.purpose: Saves vendor company name, GSTIN, PAN, and office address.
endpoints.useCase: Used in Vendor Onboarding Step 1 to set up business profile.
endpoints.flow: Vendor fills in company details -> Server saves profile -> App moves to next step.

endpoints.purpose: Saves whether the vendor provides drivers along with their machines.
endpoints.useCase: Used in Vendor Onboarding Step 2.
endpoints.flow: Vendor selects Yes or No -> Server saves choice -> App shows skills selection if Yes, or moves to machine list if No.

endpoints.purpose: Gets all machine skills currently added to the vendor profile.
endpoints.useCase: Used when viewing or editing skills in profile settings.
endpoints.flow: Vendor opens Skills screen -> Server returns current skills -> App displays skill badges.

endpoints.purpose: Saves machine skill categories and runs Digio OCR on driving license / certification.
endpoints.useCase: Used during onboarding when vendor selects equipment skills and uploads certifications.
endpoints.flow: Vendor selects machine types and uploads certificate -> Server sends document to Digio OCR -> If Digio verifies name and license class, skill is marked 'Verified' -> App moves to fleet registration.

endpoints.purpose: Registers the vendor's machines and runs automated Digio RC verification.
endpoints.useCase: Used during onboarding to add the initial fleet of machines.
endpoints.flow: Vendor enters vehicle number and uploads RC photo -> Server calls Digio RC OCR -> Digio extracts vehicle number, chassis, and owner name -> If Digio approves, RC is marked 'Verified' -> App moves to KYC step.

endpoints.purpose: Uploads company registration papers (Incorporation certificate, PAN, GST, Board Resolution) and runs Digio corporate validation.
endpoints.useCase: Used during corporate vendor onboarding for legal verification.
endpoints.flow: Vendor uploads company documents -> Server calls Digio to verify GSTIN registry and Company PAN -> If Digio confirms corporate match, documents are marked 'Verified' -> App completes KYC step.

endpoints.purpose: Saves operator personal name, driving experience (years), and city.
endpoints.useCase: Used in Driver Onboarding Step 1.
endpoints.flow: Driver fills in personal details -> Server saves profile -> App advances to next step.

endpoints.purpose: Saves machine types the operator is certified to drive.
endpoints.useCase: Used in Driver Onboarding Step 3.
endpoints.flow: Driver selects certified machines -> Server saves driving skills -> App moves to license upload.

endpoints.purpose: Uploads Commercial Driving License and Aadhaar card and runs Digio Driving License verification.
endpoints.useCase: Used during driver KYC verification.
endpoints.flow: Driver uploads license photo -> Server sends image to Digio DL OCR -> Digio checks license number, expiry, and heavy vehicle authorization -> If Digio approves, License is marked 'Verified' -> App marks KYC step complete.

endpoints.purpose: Submits the completed application for Link2Build admin approval after all Digio and KYC steps are done.
endpoints.useCase: Used when user finishes all onboarding steps and taps 'Submit Application'.
endpoints.flow: User taps Submit -> Server confirms Digio checks passed and changes status to 'Pending Approval' -> App displays Under Review screen.

endpoints.purpose: Uploads a photo or PDF document to secure cloud storage (AWS S3).
endpoints.useCase: Used whenever the user takes a photo or picks a file for RC, License, PAN, or Cheque.
endpoints.flow: User selects photo -> App uploads image to server -> Server saves file to S3 and returns document ID -> App attaches ID to form.

endpoints.purpose: Sends an uploaded document to Digio AI OCR to extract text and verify government authenticity.
endpoints.useCase: Used right after uploading RC, Driving License, or PAN to auto-verify details.
endpoints.flow: Document uploaded -> Server calls Digio OCR API -> Digio extracts fields (owner name, vehicle number, expiry) -> If Digio matches, document is marked 'Verified' -> App auto-fills form.

endpoints.purpose: Checks if document verification has finished.
endpoints.useCase: Used by the app to check whether document review is pending, approved, or rejected.
endpoints.flow: App checks document status -> Server returns Digio review result -> App shows Approved or Re-upload badge.

endpoints.purpose: Receives automated verification status callbacks from Digio when background document or bank checks finish.
endpoints.useCase: Used by Digio's servers to notify Link2Build when a bank penny-drop or background OCR check is complete.
endpoints.flow: Digio finishes verification -> Digio calls this webhook with result -> Server marks document and KYC as 'Verified' or 'Rejected' -> Partner account status updates automatically.

endpoints.purpose: Runs Digio automated RC verification on a machine's registration certificate.
endpoints.useCase: Used during fleet registration to check vehicle RC.
endpoints.flow: App triggers RC verification -> Server calls Digio RC OCR -> If Digio validates registration number and chassis, RC is marked 'Verified'.

endpoints.purpose: Checks bank IFSC code and gets official bank and branch name.

endpoints.flow: User types IFSC code -> Server checks bank database -> App displays verified bank name and branch below input.
